items.title: 2027 pension rises await formal government approval
items.body: Under government plans, contributory pensions would rise 3.5% in 2027, based on average inflation. Minimum and non-contributory pensions would rise between 8.8% and 14.2%, and the minimum living income 14.1%. The government plans to approve a Royal Decree-law after the final November CPI data on December 15, 2026.

items.title: Spain votes on November 29: polling hours explained
items.body: Spain holds its general election on Sunday, November 29, with polling stations open from 9.00 to 20.00. Voters use a white ballot for Congress and a sepia one for the Senate. According to INE (national statistics institute), 38,728,356 people can vote.

items.title: Lower fuel prices ease November inflation to 4.1%
items.body: Spain's annual CPI inflation fell 0.8 points to 4.1% in November, according to a flash estimate from INE (national statistics institute). Lower fuel prices drove a 0.6% monthly fall in prices. Core inflation, excluding energy and fresh food, eased to 2.6%.

items.title: Capsized diesel tanker faces disputed tow to Cartagena
items.body: Maritime authorities have ordered the capsized Med Emre tanker to be towed upside down to Cartagena, with arrival expected on Monday, November 30. Murcia's regional government opposes the plan over environmental risks. A very slight pollution slick was detected on November 27; authorities ruled out unloading the diesel at sea as unviable.

items.title: Madrid teachers march over pay and school conditions
items.body: Thousands marched in Madrid on November 27, a month and a half into an indefinite teachers' strike seeking smaller classes, better pay, and classroom climate control. They also opposed regional instructions barring strike posters in schools. The central government has asked Madrid to withdraw the instructions.

items.title: Self-employed workers face a substantial retirement pension gap
items.body: The average retirement pension for an autónomo (self-employed worker) is €1,063.5 a month, against €1,735.9 for employees. Associations link the gap to low contribution bases, often driven by cash shortages. Autónomos also retire about 1.2 years later than other workers, at an average age of 66.6.

items.title: At least 15 die on crossing to El Hierro
items.body: At least 15 people died during a boat crossing from Gambia before rescuers reached it off El Hierro on November 27. Early investigations indicate its engine failed three days earlier, leaving it drifting without provisions. A helicopter took six seriously ill survivors to hospital.

items.title: Madrid Plan Vive tenants dispute 4.9% rent rises
items.body: Tenants in Madrid's Plan Vive rental homes have received notices of 4.9% rent rises based on October CPI. Congress has approved a 2% cap under the Decreto Maricarmen, but managing firms are applying CPI-based rises, and the article says the regional government backs them. Several tenants plan to file claims.

items.title: More young people outside work and education
items.body: Spain had 753,200 people aged 16-24 neither studying nor working in the third quarter, up 98,400 from a year earlier. Their share reached 15.2%, the highest since 2020, according to Asempleo's analysis of the labour survey. The rise was concentrated among 16-19-year-olds.

items.title: Measles keeps circulating as vaccination coverage falls
items.body: Spain recorded 165 confirmed measles cases through November 22, with 89.7% locally acquired. It lost its measles-elimination status at the start of 2026 after transmission resumed for over a year. Second-dose vaccination coverage fell to 91% in 2025. A specialist urges health workers to seek out unvaccinated people.

items.title: Marc Márquez announces retirement after tenth world title
items.body: MotoGP rider Marc Márquez, 33, announced on November 27 that he will retire at the end of the 2026 season. His final race will be at Cheste, Valencia, a week after he won his tenth world title in Portugal. Eight of his titles came in the premier class.

items.title: Free catalogue maps 6,361 Pyrenean lakes and ponds
items.body: Scientists have created LacusPyr, the first joint catalogue of 6,361 lakes and ponds across the Spanish, French, and Andorran Pyrenees. Free to download from Dryad, it gives each water body mapped coordinates and an identifier. The authors hope it will support research and conservation.
